description: Find health facilities (hospitals, clinics, PHCs) near a WGS84 point, sorted by distance. Example: { lat: 6.44, lng: 3.41, radius_km: 10, limit: 10 }. Data: GRID3 health facilities, CC BY 4.0.
name: find_facilities_near

category.description: Facility category/level, e.g. hospital / clinic / phc (null when the source omits it)

distanceKm.description: Great-circle distance from the query point in km (only on findNear results)

id.description: Stable facility id (fixture id, or the source's global/object id)

ownership.description: Ownership, e.g. public / private (null when the source omits it)

retrievedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the record was fetched

title: Find Nigerian health facilities near a point
